text:
Ellie (Marketing): Hey team — draft hero + benchmark snippet below. Need a quick legal sweep on the claim and a confirm from Sales on webinar CTA + inbound routing. Hoping to lock copy by EOD so we can schedule for Wed 4/15. TL;DR: short headline, one benchmark pullout, gated webinar CTA.

Ellie (Marketing): Draft hero: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and up to 3x lower serving cost in our benchmark."
Bench pullout (one line): "Sparkline: median token cost reduced 3x after batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)."
CTA (inline): Register for the launch webinar (gated).

Ellie (Marketing): Proposed embed for CTA+UTM block:
```
/cta?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=sparkline_launch
hubspot_form_id=hs_98765
hidden_fields: account_size, pql_score
assign_owner: sales_round_robin
```

Sam (Sales): looks good. Can we set hidden field `account_size=enterprise` for inbound from the blog by default? Sales wants a clear enterprise bucket. Also can we tag `source_detail=blog_launch` so SDRs can prioritize. :+1:

Ben (Product): Minor ask — can the hero call out latency SLO instead of generic "predictable latency"? e.g., "predictable sub-150ms 95th-percentile for typical prompts". Customers ask about latency first. Keep the cost claim but modify wording per legal.

Janet (Legal): Quick legal note: we can't state an absolute "3x lower" without linking to the benchmark methodology and sample size. Suggest phrasing: "reduces estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (see methodology)." Also avoid "cuts" — use "reduces" or "lowers". Add a short footnote link to the benchmark doc. I can sign off on that wording.

Maria (Growth): For lead routing: prefer `hubspot_owner=round_robin` + `lead_tier=marketing_high` for webinar registrants. Recommend A/B test: variant A gated webinar (form) + variant B direct CTA (no form) to measure lead quality. Also add `utm_content=hero_cta_v1` so we can attribute.

Sam (Sales): +1 to `lead_tier=marketing_high`. For enterprise traffic we need `region` and `company_size` if available — but hidden fields are fine. Can we set `notify_channel=#sales-inbound` for enterprise-sized leads?

Ellie (Marketing): ok — I'll update hidden fields to: `account_size`, `company_size`, `region`, `pql_score`, `lead_tier`. Will add `utm_content` variants for A/B.

Janet (Legal): Approved if phrasing is changed to include "estimated" and linked methodology. Also move any comparative language to "in our benchmark".

Ben (Product): Approved on the latency line if we use the measured 95th pctl value and call out prompt length (e.g., <=512 tokens). I can attach the mini-graph for the bench pullout.

Maria (Growth): For the A/B test, recommend 50/50 split for first 48 hours, track MQL rate and webinar attendance conversion. I'll set up the experiment in Amplitude + HubSpot.

PublishBot: Scheduled draft publish job created: job_id=pub_20260415_0900, status=waiting_for_final_copy.

Ellie (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll make the wording changes:
- Hero: "Ship LLM features with predictable sub-150ms 95th-percentile latency for typical prompts and reduces estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (methodology link)."
- Add bench footnote link and attach the methodology doc.
- Implement HubSpot hidden fields and `notify_channel=#sales-inbound` mapping for enterprise.
- Create A/B CTA variants with `utm_content=hero_cta_v1` and `hero_cta_v2`.

Ellie (Marketing): Can I get final thumbs by 5pm PT? Janet/Sam/Ben/Maria please react or say "ok".

Sam (Sales): ok

Janet (Legal): ok

Ben (Product): ok

Maria (Growth): ok — I'll also post the experiment URL once set up. :rocket:

Ellie (Marketing): Awesome, locking changes now. Will drop updated draft and the publish window in this thread in 30m. :memo:
